BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 10-year
BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond. This series represents the prevailing market interest rate for the 10-year Government of Canada bond and is used as a reference for financial market analysis and reporting.

BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 2-year
BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 2-year benchmark bond. This series reflects the prevailing interest rate for the 2-year term and is used to monitor short-term government borrowing costs.

BD.CDN.3YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 3-year
BD.CDN.3YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 3-year benchmark bond. This series measures the market interest rate for the Government of Canada’s 3-year bond, which serves as a reference rate for Canadian dollar-denominated debt securities.

BD.CDN.5YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 5-year
BD.CDN.5YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 5-year benchmark bond. This series reports the prevailing yield for the 5-year maturity point on the Canadian government bond yield curve.

BD.CDN.7YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 7-year
BD.CDN.7YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 7-year benchmark bond. This series represents the prevailing market yield for the 7-year maturity point on the Government of Canada yield curve.

BD.CDN.LONG.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, long-term
BD.CDN.LONG.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada long-term benchmark bond. This series represents the prevailing interest rate for the designated long-term benchmark bond and is used in the Bank of Canada’s reporting of financial market conditions.

BD.CDN.RRB.DQ.YLD.label: Real Return Bonds yield, long-term
BD.CDN.RRB.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on Government of Canada Real Return Bonds. These bonds are part of the government securities held by the Bank of Canada and are reported in millions of Canadian dollars.

CEER_BROADM.label: Monthly real Canadian effective exchange rates
CEER_BROADM.description: The monthly value of the real Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated using a weighted average of bilateral exchange rates against a basket of major trading partners’ currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_BROADN.label: Daily nominal Canadian effective exchange rates
CEER_BROADN.description: The daily value of the nominal Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated by using a weighted average of bilateral exchange rates against a basket of major trading partners’ currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_BROADNM.label: Monthly nominal Canadian effective exchange rates
CEER_BROADNM.description: The monthly value of the nominal Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated using a weighted average of bilateral exchange rates against a basket of major trading partners’ currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_BROADN_XUS.label: Daily nominal CEER excluding the US dollar
CEER_BROADN_XUS.description: The daily value of the nominal Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, excluding the US dollar from the basket of currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_BROADN_XUSM.label: Monthly nominal CEER excluding the US dollar
CEER_BROADN_XUSM.description: The monthly value of the nominal Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, excluding the US dollar from the basket of currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_BROAD_XUSM.label: Monthly real CEER excluding the US dollar
CEER_BROAD_XUSM.description: The monthly value of the real Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, excluding the US dollar from the basket of currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_MCM.label: Monthly real CEER versus major currencies
CEER_MCM.description: The monthly value of the real Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated against a basket of major currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_MCN.label: Daily nominal CEER versus major currencies
CEER_MCN.description: The daily value of the nominal Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated against a basket of major currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_MCNM.label: Monthly nominal CEER versus major currencies
CEER_MCNM.description: The monthly value of the nominal Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated against a basket of major currencies. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_OITPM.label: Monthly real CEER versus other important trading partners
CEER_OITPM.description: The monthly value of the real Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated against the currencies of other important trading partners. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_OITPN.label: Daily nominal CEER versus other important trading partners
CEER_OITPN.description: The daily value of the nominal Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated against the currencies of other important trading partners. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CEER_OITPNM.label: Monthly nominal CEER versus other important trading partners
CEER_OITPNM.description: The monthly value of the nominal Canadian effective exchange rate (CEER) index, calculated against the currencies of other important trading partners. The index is set to 100 for the base year 1999.

CORRA.COMPOUNDED.INDEX.label: CORRA Compounded Index
CORRA.COMPOUNDED.INDEX.description: A measure of the cumulative impact of CORRA compounding over time, starting from a base value of 100 on June 12, 2020. This index, provided for informational purposes only, can be used to calculate CORRA compounded between any two dates.

CORRA_CALCULATION_METHODOLOGY.label: CORRA: Calculation methodology
CORRA_CALCULATION_METHODOLOGY.description: Indicates the methodology used by the Bank of Canada to calculate CORRA based on transaction-level repo data.

CORRA_MINIMUM_VOLUME_THRESHOLD.label: CORRA: Minimum volume threshold
CORRA_MINIMUM_VOLUME_THRESHOLD.description: The minimum dollar volume threshold of trades eligible for CORRA. It represents the volume removed during the trimming process in the CORRA calculation.

CORRA_MODE_RATE.label: CORRA: Mode
CORRA_MODE_RATE.description: The modal rate — the interest‑rate level with the largest traded volume among eligible CORRA transactions for a given day.

CORRA_NUMBER_OF_SUBMITTERS.label: CORRA: Number of unique data submitters
CORRA_NUMBER_OF_SUBMITTERS.description: The number of unique data submitters used in the calculation of CORRA before trimming.

CORRA_PUBLICATION_STATUS.label: CORRA: Publication status
CORRA_PUBLICATION_STATUS.description: Indicates whether CORRA has been published for the given day.

CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_25.label: CORRA: Rate at 25th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_25.description: The rate at the 25th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_5.label: CORRA: Rate at 5th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_5.description: The rate at the 5th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_75.label: CORRA: Rate at 75th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_75.description: The rate at the 75th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_95.label: CORRA: Rate at 95th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_95.description: The rate at the 95th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

CORRA_RATE_AT_TRIM.label: CORRA: Rate at which daily trading volume is trimmed
CORRA_RATE_AT_TRIM.description: The rate at which the bottom 25 percent of CORRA volume was trimmed.

CORRA_TOTAL_VOLUME.label: CORRA: Total dollar trading volume of all trades eligible
CORRA_TOTAL_VOLUME.description: The total nominal value of CORRA transactions before trimming the bottom 25 percent.

CORRA_TRIMMED_VOLUME.label: Trimmed dollar volume of trades eligible for CORRA ($)
CORRA_TRIMMED_VOLUME.description: Trimmed dollar volume of trades eligible for CORRA ($)

CORRA_WEIGHTED_MEAN_RATE.label: CORRA: Mean
CORRA_WEIGHTED_MEAN_RATE.description: The volume‑weighted average rate of eligible overnight repurchase transactions used in the calculation of CORRA.

CPIW.label: CPIW, percentage change year-over-year (unadjusted)
CPIW.description: The year-over-year percentage change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) with basket weights adjusted inversely to component variability and excluding the effect of changes in indirect taxes.

CPI_COMMON.label: CPI-common
CPI_COMMON.description: The monthly value of the common component of Consumer Price Index (CPI).

CPI_MEDIAN.label: CPI-median
CPI_MEDIAN.description: The monthly value of the median Consumer Price Index (CPI). This series measures the central tendency of price changes across CPI components, excluding extreme movements.

CPI_TRIM.label: CPI-trim
CPI_TRIM.description: The monthly value of the trim component of the Consumer Price Index (CPI). This measure excludes CPI components whose rates of change in a given month are located in the tails of the distribution of price changes.
